posts.headline: Thirteen editions of chasing the African Bald Fraud and mjwithgoldhoops just keeps laughing, now 9-2 with a league-best 1521.56 points and a middle-tier pedigree that's starting to look like false advertising.
posts.detail: A 4th-place average finish in two seasons says 'solid, not special' — but a league-high scoring output at 9-2 is doing some heavy rewriting of that résumé in real time.

posts.headline: Thirteen straight editions of burying Thicks and the reigning champ is somehow still 7-4 while owning the worst points total in the entire league at 1178.5.
posts.detail: One title and a career 14-14 record means the ring is real, but scoring under 1,200 points through 11 weeks is how a defending champ turns into a cautionary tale instead of a dynasty.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh keeps bricking its way to a 12-average-finish destiny, now 2-9 with a league-worst 1141.04 points that make the nickname look charitable.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record and a 12-average-finish pedigree aren't bad luck at this point — they're a business model, and the untalented tenth just keeps delivering on the promise.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-11 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has officially become this league's Book of Lamentations.
posts.detail: Drafting a defensive player first overall was the original sin, and a winless season with 1181.06 points is the plague that just won't lift — someone check if he's still asking folks to pick Bible or Belt.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 8-3 with 1511.84 points, the second-best mark in the league, and triciagloston is still getting zero respect for it.
posts.detail: A 6-7-1 career record coming in meant nobody expected this, but she's now outscoring everyone except the Bald Fraud himself — the silence around her is becoming its own scandal.
